analyst_view.overall: Málaga are bottom with 5 points and still without a league win under Juanfran Funes; they lost 1-0 at Osasuna last Sunday. Athletic, 8th under Edin Terzic, lost at home to Espanyol last time out and have no European game this week. Terzic gets Yeray Álvarez and Berenguer back in full training on Thursday, so Athletic's only confirmed absences are strikers Guruzeta and Sannadi and centre-back Vivian; with no fit specialist striker the Williams brothers, Berenguer and Sancet carry the attack. Málaga still miss Lobete, Ochoa and Rafita, but Murillo trained fully after his eyebrow cut, Calero is back and Aznou returns from his ban. No referee named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals and take nothing off for the absences here. Athletic have no fit specialist striker with Guruzeta and Sannadi out, which pulls their side down a little, though Yeray's return at the back also helps them keep a weak Málaga attack quiet. Guruzeta has been out since October, so Athletic's recent scoring already reflects part of it; I trim only slightly, to about 2.3.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners, with Málaga's low recent corner count already taken off. Athletic attack wide through Nico and Iñaki Williams and Berenguer, now back in full training, and Málaga at home have to push for a first win. Nothing new points either way, so I stay at 10.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards, a fairly calm game by La Liga standards, with both sides' recent cards already counted. The referee is not named yet and neither side has a suspension issue now that Aznou is back from his ban. A bottom side desperate for a win can get tense late on, but the numbers already know Málaga's position and form, so I stay at 4.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.9 shots, with both sides' recent shot counts already added; Athletic should take most of them. Their missing strikers change who shoots more than how often, since Terzic still has the Williams brothers, Berenguer and Sancet. I stay at 26.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target, with Málaga's better recent accuracy and Athletic's slightly worse accuracy already counted. Without Guruzeta and Sannadi Athletic lack a central finisher, but they have played that way for weeks, which their recent form already shows. I stay at 8.8.
